title: Saving a technician who stays on shows no warning
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, who holds nothing except the work named below.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member A, so staff member A holds open work.
  • Choose a new phone number for staff member A.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Replace the phone number with the new phone number.
  3. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens with Technician on.

Step 2:

  • The phone field shows the new phone number.

Step 3:

  • No warning window shows.
  • The window closes.
  • Staff member A's row still shows "Yes" in the Technician column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-N2: “If the save does not turn Technician off (it was already off, or stays on), no warning shows.”
  • S1-R7: “A save that turns Technician on never shows a warning. A save that turns it off may show the Turn Off Technician warning first (Story 2).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
